owner_profiles_text_length_check.name: owner_profiles_text_length_check
owner_profiles_text_length_check.value: ("owner_profiles"."first_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."first_name") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."last_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."last_name") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."legal_name" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."legal_name") <= 200) and ("owner_profiles"."phone" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."phone") <= 20) and ("owner_profiles"."address_line" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."address_line") <= 200) and ("owner_profiles"."city" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."city") <= 100) and ("owner_profiles"."postal_code" is null or char_length("owner_profiles"."postal_code") <= 12)

parking_hours_exceptions_period_check.name: parking_hours_exceptions_period_check
parking_hours_exceptions_period_check.value: ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" is null) = ("parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" is null) and ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" is null or ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" >= 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" <= 1440 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" < "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" and "parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" % 30 = 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closes_minute" % 30 = 0))

parking_hours_exceptions_closed_part_che.name: parking_hours_exceptions_closed_part_check
parking_hours_exceptions_closed_part_che.value: ("parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_from_minute" is null) = ("parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_to_minute" is null) and ("parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_from_minute" is null or ("parking_hours_exceptions"."opens_minute" is null and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_from_minute" >= 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_to_minute" <= 1440 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_from_minute" < "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_to_minute" and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_from_minute" % 30 = 0 and "parking_hours_exceptions"."closed_to_minute" % 30 = 0))

parking_locations_status_email_idx.name: parking_locations_status_email_idx
parking_locations_status_email_idx.where: "parking_locations"."owner_id" is not null and "parking_locations"."status" in ('in_review', 'changes_requested', 'published') and "parking_locations"."notified_status" is distinct from "parking_locations"."status"

parking_locations_complete_check.name: parking_locations_complete_check
parking_locations_complete_check.value: "parking_locations"."status" in ('draft', 'changes_requested') or ("parking_locations"."name" is not null and "parking_locations"."address" is not null and "parking_locations"."area_id" is not null and "parking_locations"."location" is not null and "parking_locations"."hourly_rate_minor" is not null)

parking_locations_text_length_check.name: parking_locations_text_length_check
parking_locations_text_length_check.value: ("parking_locations"."name" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."name") between 1 and 120) and ("parking_locations"."address" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."address") between 1 and 200) and ("parking_locations"."description" is null or char_length("parking_locations"."description") <= 2000)

parking_price_rules_night_check.name: parking_price_rules_night_check
parking_price_rules_night_check.value: ("parking_price_rules"."kind" = 'night') = ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" is not null and "parking_price_rules"."to_minute" is not null) and ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" is null or ("parking_price_rules"."from_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "parking_price_rules"."to_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "parking_price_rules"."from_minute" <> "parking_price_rules"."to_minute"))

parking_price_rules_dated_check.name: parking_price_rules_dated_check
parking_price_rules_dated_check.value: ("parking_price_rules"."kind" = 'dated') = ("parking_price_rules"."starts_on" is not null and "parking_price_rules"."ends_on" is not null) and ("parking_price_rules"."starts_on" is null or "parking_price_rules"."starts_on" <= "parking_price_rules"."ends_on")

email_outbox_recipient_check.name: email_outbox_recipient_check
email_outbox_recipient_check.value: ("email_outbox"."user_id" is null) <> ("email_outbox"."invite_id" is null) and ("email_outbox"."invite_id" is null) = ("email_outbox"."kind" <> 'listing-invite')

bookings_transfers_due_idx.name: bookings_transfers_due_idx
bookings_transfers_due_idx.where: "bookings"."payment_status" = 'succeeded' and "bookings"."status" in ('confirmed', 'cancelled') and ("bookings"."transfer_status" is null or "bookings"."transfer_status" = 'sending') and ("bookings"."refund_minor" is null or "bookings"."refund_minor" < "bookings"."total_minor")

bookings_confirmed_check.name: bookings_confirmed_check
bookings_confirmed_check.value: "bookings"."status" not in ('confirmed', 'cancelled') or ("bookings"."vehicle_plate" is not null and "bookings"."confirmed_at" is not null)

bookings_cancelled_check.name: bookings_cancelled_check
bookings_cancelled_check.value: case when "bookings"."status" = 'cancelled' then "bookings"."cancelled_at" is not null and "bookings"."refund_minor" is not null and "bookings"."cancelled_by" in ('driver', 'owner') else "bookings"."cancelled_at" is null and "bookings"."cancelled_by" is null and "bookings"."refund_minor" is null end

bookings_refund_status_check.name: bookings_refund_status_check
bookings_refund_status_check.value: "bookings"."refund_status" is null or ("bookings"."refund_status" in ('owed', 'sent', 'failed') and "bookings"."status" = 'cancelled' and "bookings"."payment_status" = 'succeeded' and "bookings"."refund_minor" is not null and "bookings"."refund_minor" > 0 and ("bookings"."refund_status" in ('sent', 'failed')) = ("bookings"."stripe_refund_id" is not null))

bookings_transfer_check.name: bookings_transfer_check
bookings_transfer_check.value: "bookings"."transfer_status" is null or ("bookings"."transfer_status" in ('sending', 'sent') and "bookings"."payment_status" = 'succeeded' and "bookings"."refund_status" is distinct from 'owed' and "bookings"."transfer_minor" is not null and "bookings"."commission_minor" is not null and "bookings"."transfer_minor" > 0 and "bookings"."commission_minor" >= 0 and "bookings"."transfer_minor" + "bookings"."commission_minor" = "bookings"."total_minor" - coalesce("bookings"."refund_minor", 0) and ("bookings"."transfer_status" = 'sent') = ("bookings"."transferred_at" is not null))

bookings_payment_check.name: bookings_payment_check
bookings_payment_check.value: ("bookings"."payment_intent_id" is null) = ("bookings"."payment_status" is null) and ("bookings"."payment_status" is null or "bookings"."payment_status" in ('pending', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'refunding', 'refunded', 'canceled'))

booking_payees_transfer_check.name: booking_payees_transfer_check
booking_payees_transfer_check.value: "booking_payees"."transfer_status" is null or ("booking_payees"."transfer_status" in ('sending', 'sent') and "booking_payees"."transfer_minor" is not null and "booking_payees"."transfer_minor" >= 0 and ("booking_payees"."transfer_status" = 'sent') = ("booking_payees"."transferred_at" is not null) and ("booking_payees"."stripe_transfer_id" is not null) = ("booking_payees"."transfer_status" = 'sent' and "booking_payees"."transfer_minor" > 0))

listing_invites_token_check.name: listing_invites_token_check
listing_invites_token_check.value: ("listing_invites"."token_hash" is null) = ("listing_invites"."expires_at" is null) and ("listing_invites"."token_hash" is null or "listing_invites"."token_hash" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')
